command: claude --permission-mode manual (interactive TUI, driven under a pty), with a project-local .claude/settings.json registering PermissionRequest
note: The gate is `PermissionRequest`, NOT `Notification`: the only Notification this run fired was the idle `Claude is waiting for your input`. The composed fixture's belief that a permission arrives as Notification is what let install/claude.rs ship without registering PermissionRequest at all — the decoder has always handled it, the bytes just never arrived. Home path redacted to /Users/dev. Redacted: the recorder's own MCP server / skill inventory (tool NAMES only, no credentials) to generic placeholders — a public repo and an immutable crates.io tarball are the wrong home for one machine's tooling roster, and no decoder reads those fields.
